name: crumb
title: Crumb
description: A bakery theme that opens on the printed greaseproof sheet the loaf goes home in — the shop's name step-and-repeated in slanted typewriter capitals, edge to edge, in one rye-crust brown — with the name and menu typed on the white label that seals it.

tokens.--font-type: the typewriter voice: the name repeated on the sheet, the site title and menu links, headings, table headings, dates, menu section labels, prices, hours labels, the button
tokens.--font-body: body text, menu item names and descriptions
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of everything set in typewriter capitals
tokens.--word-space: extra space between the words of body text, so a new sentence never runs into the full stop before it
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the greaseproof sheet (white by day, crust brown at night)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, menu item names and prices, the name in the footer
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: menu descriptions, dates, post summaries, list markers, page numbers, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links, and the focus ring wherever it falls on the sheet
tokens.--color-print: the site name repeated across the sheet at the top of every page: a tint of the ink, lighter than the type so the label leads
tokens.--color-rule: the heavy ink rules: under the printed sheet, above each heading, menu section and the footer, under table headings, the edge of quotations, the dotted divider
tokens.--color-hairline: thin dividing lines: between menu items, between posts, under table rows
tokens.--color-label: the white labels: the title label on the sheet, the hours card, menu section labels, the label on an item's page and on the not-found page; also the text of the button inside the hours card
tokens.--color-label-ink: text, keyline, dotted lines and focus ring on the white labels, and the button inside the hours card
tokens.--color-label-muted: small secondary text on a white label: hours labels, the section name on an item's page
tokens.--color-btn: the booking button when it stands alone in a page (and its text when hovered)
tokens.--color-btn-ink: text on the booking button when it stands alone in a page
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--color-shadow: the hard edge of cut paper along the bottom of every white label
tokens.--band-home: height of the printed sheet on the home page (other pages keep it just tall enough for the label)
tokens.--slant: angle of the printed rows on the sheet
tokens.--print-size: size of the name printed across the sheet (it grows with the screen, between a floor and a ceiling, and again on very wide screens)
tokens.--print-pitch: distance between printed rows, as a multiple of their size
tokens.--keyline: weight of the line printed just inside the edge of every label
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules, the focus ring, the button's outline and the underline of the current menu link
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of labels, the button, code blocks and images
tokens.--measure: width of the page column, and of the row the title label sits in
tokens.--shelf: width of the left column that holds the section labels on the menu
tokens.--space-1: the white margin of a label outside its keyline, and the smallest gaps
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between the rows of a label, under dates and small headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter, the gap between paragraphs, and the padding of menu rows
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, the side padding of labels, and the sheet's padding above and below the title label
tokens.--space-5: large gap above page titles, section headings and the footer
